prompt.description: What happens in the video. Describe shots with time ranges (0-4s, 4-8s), camera moves, subjects, lighting and the sound (dialogue, ambience, music or 'no music').
examples: A red fox trots along a frozen riverbank at dawn, breath steaming. 0-3s: low tracking shot beside the fox. 3-5s: it stops and looks straight into the lens. Sound: crunching snow, distant crows, no music.
prompt.title: Prompt

image.description: First-frame image (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 24 MiB and 40 MP). Resized and center-cropped to the output canvas.
image.title: Image

last_frame_image.description: Last-frame image, same limits as image. Can be used alone or together with image.
last_frame_image.title: Last Frame Image

duration.description: Video length in whole seconds, 3 to 15. Billed per output second.
duration.title: Duration

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. auto follows the prompt, or the first keyframe when one is given.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

resolution.description: 480p and 768p are native. 1080p, 2k and 4k generate at 768p and upscale once, keeping audio and frame rate.
resolution.title: Resolution

rewrite.description: Let Pika expand the prompt before generation. Turn off to use the prompt verbatim.
rewrite.title: Rewrite

audio_stems.description: Also return the soundtrack split into Dialogue, Music and Effect WAV stems. Billed per stem second on top of the video.
audio_stems.title: Audio Stems

stems_channel_mode.description: Audio stems only. mono downmixes before separation; stereo keeps both channels.
stems_channel_mode.title: Stems Channel Mode

title: AppInput
